Subject: Integrator onboarding: success checklist & next steps

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Integratech is excited about the Redwood runtime. To make our integration successful on the pilot, I've attached a short "Integrator_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf" that outlines the typical milestones we see with SIs and ISVs (security review, test workload, SA bootcamp, pilot metrics).

Quick asks to get started:
- Can your team confirm a target week for a 2-day Solution Architect bootcamp (we typically aim for 4-6 SAs)?
- Which internal contact will handle the procurement/PO once we sign a partner addendum?
- Do you have a sandbox model and service account we can use for end-to-end tests?

I've copied Miguel from Allied — they will help run the integration tests and training for their consultants.

Attachments: Integrator_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (1 page)

Best,
Samantha Lee
Partnerships, Integratech
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/samanthalee

--
Samantha Lee
Integratech | partnerships@integratech.com

Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integrator onboarding: success checklist & next steps

Samantha — thanks for the checklist, looks good.

Proposed next steps from Redwood:
1) SA Bootcamp: we can run a two-day remote bootcamp the week of Sep 14 or Sep 21. We will cover deployment patterns (hosted vs. dedicated), model routing, KV/prefix caching, and a hands-on workshop with a sample integration.
2) Sandbox & service account: we'll provision a sandbox project and provide a scoped API key for Integratech; security will be limited to test datasets (no customer PII).
3) Procurement: Marissa will own the partner addendum and finance conversation; Vanessa will lead enablement and the SA schedule.

I'm attaching our Partner_Playbook_v1.2.pdf — it includes the partner SLA options, enablement timeline, and typical test harness we ask partners to run.

Can you confirm which bootcamp week you prefer? If Sep 14 works we'll block dates and send calendar invites.

HubSpot: I've created a deal (DEAL-4892) and linked Integratech + Allied. See the HubSpot link in the follow-up.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Samantha / team — added a proposed SA_Bootcamp_Agenda.xlsx with a 2-day schedule. Highlights:
- Day 1: Redwood architecture, runtime tuning, batching/caching patterns, hands-on model routing lab.
- Day 2: Troubleshooting, observability (Console walkthrough), and a guided integration test using sample workloads.

Logistics notes:
- We recommend 4 SAs per training cohort for maximum hands-on time. If you want more attendees we can split into two parallel sessions.
- We'll request one test dataset and a short list of target SLA/latency expectations to tailor the labs.

Link to shared folder with slides and labs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XyZ-integrator-onboarding

If Sep 14 is the target I can confirm instructors (2 Redwood SAs) and reserve the remote lab environment.

Thanks,
